parameters.query:
insert into contacts (tenant_id, name, email, phone, company, source)
values ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6)
on conflict (tenant_id, email) do update
  set name = coalesce(excluded.name, contacts.name),
      phone = coalesce(excluded.phone, contacts.phone),
      company = coalesce(excluded.company, contacts.company)
returning id;

nodes.name: Upsert Contact
nodes.notes: REQUIRES: unique constraint contacts_tenant_email_unique (tenant_id, email). Set the 'Elliot Postgres (service role)' credential manually after import.

parameters.query:
insert into leads (tenant_id, contact_id, status, score, qualification_answers)
values ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5)
on conflict (tenant_id, contact_id) do update
  set status = excluded.status,
      score = excluded.score,
      qualification_answers = leads.qualification_answers || excluded.qualification_answers,
      updated_at = now()
returning id, status, score;

nodes.name: Upsert Lead
nodes.notes: REQUIRES: unique constraint leads_tenant_contact_unique (tenant_id, contact_id). Set the 'Elliot Postgres (service role)' credential manually after import.
